supersedes_interpretation: The useful_accepted_draft_tokens field in acceptance-epoch-reconstruction-r1.json was mislabeled: it is committed output minus one per verification, not exact useful draft acceptance at clipped final steps.
reasoning: Sampler output is an accepted draft prefix followed by one correction/bonus token. Final budget truncation can discard that last token; subtracting one for every clipped final step therefore undercounts useful drafts by one per clipped request.
assumptions: Two proposed drafts per active verification; raw accepted aggregate and reconstructed requests have matching scope.
Only final output budget truncation accounts for the aggregate 206 excess; no unrecorded stop-string or external abort.
No individual final raw sampler outcome is inferred uniquely.
